notes.text:
Polysomnography Report
Date: 03/06/2025
Patient: Stanley O'Conner, 83 y.o. M

Attended PSG 03/06/2025. Study revealed moderate-severe sleep apnea. AHI 32.8/h. CA+MA 5% of total AHI. Oximetry showed intermittent desats to 85%. Sleep architecture fragmented with reduced REM and N3 stages. Periodic limb movements within normal limits. No significant arrhythmias noted on ECG channel. CPAP titration recommended given severity of apnea and oxygen desaturation profile.

Otolaryngology Consultation Note
Date: 09/14/2026
Patient: Stanley O'Conner, 84yo M

Chief complaint: Evaluation for hypoglossal nerve stimulator (HGNS).

HPI: 84yo M referred for HGNS eval.

Exam: Tonsils 1+, no other obstruction.

DISE 09/04/2026: AP velum collapse, no CCC.

Assessment: Findings consistent with partial velar collapse without complete concentric collapse. Tonsillar hypertrophy minimal.

Plan: Continue evaluation for HGNS candidacy. Consider further sleep study correlation and discuss with sleep medicine.
